sum: Generation Income Properties, Inc. is an internally managed real estate investment trust focused on acquiring and owning single-tenant net lease properties leased to high-credit-quality tenants. The Company's portfolio consists of retail, office, and industrial properties located across multiple states. Generation Income Properties, Inc. was established on September 19, 2015 and incorporated in Maryland.
ceo: Mr. David E. Sobelman (Chairman, President, CEO & Secretary)
